Theorem
[Derivative estimates---global] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0393, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0394 1. appD:D.23\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

If a closed Ricci flow satisfies $|\operatorname {Rm}|\leq K$ on $[0,\alpha /K]\cap [0,T)$, then for each $m\in \mathbb N$, \[ |\nabla ^m\operatorname {Rm}(x,t)|\leq \frac{C(m,n,\alpha )K}{t^{m/2}} \] on the same interval at positive times.
